title: Cyclotomic norm-defect threshold is ONE engine for e2=0 (F12) and the additive-energy clean range (F5/F13): the claimed FINITE-DEGREE escape from F5 vacuity
evidence: Two separable claims. (A) UNIFICATION (PROVEN/correct): both cited Lean lemmas ARE literally the same Norm<=M^phi(n) engine. WindowTwoLayerThreshold.qualifying_implies_char0_vanishing (threshold (2^(m-1)*|A|^2)^(2^(m-1)) < p) is the M=|A|^2, degree-<2^(m-1) structured instance of CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold.prime_le_of_cyclotomic_signed_sum (threshold M^phi(n)). Both are sorry-free, axiom-clean, in-tree. e2 IS the r-fixed (r=2, pair-sum) structured corner of the generic F5 deep-moment clean range. This structural identity is real. (B) THE HEADLINE CLAIM (REFUTED): 'finite-degree escape => non-vacuous in the prize regime / beats the Johnson L2 ceiling'. Exact arithmetic (scripts/probes/_407_conn/C026_finite_degree_escape.py): the e2 threshold EXPONENT is 2^(m-1) = n/2 = phi(n), IDENTICAL to the generic F5 exponent phi(n) at EVERY scale (verified n=8..2^30). 'Finite degree' lowers the BASE (poly-in-n) but NOT the exponent, so the provable threshold is still n^Theta(n) -- VACUOUS at prize p~n^beta, beta in [4,5]. Numerics: n=32 gives log2(T_e2)=128 vs log2(n^5)=25; prize n=2^30 gives log2(T_e2)~1.77e10 vs log2(n^5)=150 (astronomically vacuous, same failure mode as generic F5). Worse for the claim: at the FIXED depth r=2, the GENERIC F5 base is 2r=4, which is SMALLER than the e2 base (n/2)*|A|^2, so the e2 crude threshold is actually WEAKER than generic-fixed-r, not stronger -- it does NOT 'beat' anything. The attack_plan's own affirmative falsifier ('if the true norm spectrum is poly(n) the e2 face is clean at prize scale') is FALSE: worst-case log2|Res(e2Fold,Phi_2m)| grows ~ (n/2)*2log|A| (doubly exponential in m: 4.0,14.2,38.8,90.8 at n=8,16,32,64), NOT poly(n). And C008 already exhibited a GENUINE prize-FORM bad alpha in the e2 spectrum (q=139292647009 prime, q=1 mod 32, mu_32 a proper subgroup, e2 power-sum=0 mod q at n=32) -- the e2 face does NOT escape BGK, it re-encodes it as 'does this sparse cyclotomic norm have a prize-sized prime factor' (Mahler-measure/large-prime-factor of lacunary cyclotomic integers, equally open). C026 also contradicts its own cited file's honesty note (CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold.lean L54-62: 'VACUOUS there ... only certifies char-0 exactness for r=O(1)').
honest_note: The unification half is genuine and useful (a clean refactor target: WindowTwoLayer's threshold IS a corollary of prime_le_of_cyclotomic_signed_sum) -- this is why PARTIAL not REFUTED. Only the 'non-vacuous in prize regime / finite-degree escape' interpretation is refuted. Subtlety: C026 conflates 'r-uniform' (true: e2 is genuinely r=2, threshold doesn't grow with depth) with 'non-vacuous' (false: vacuity comes from the phi(n)=n/2 EXPONENT, which is present at every fixed r; fixing r never escapes it). The probe is exact integer arithmetic at toy scales n=8..64 plus closed-form exponent comparison extrapolated to n=2^30; the doubly-exponential |Res| growth and the identical phi(n)=n/2 exponent are the disproof signals. Recommend a one-line DISPROOF_LOG entry: 'C026 e2 finite-degree threshold has exponent phi(n)=n/2 (same as generic F5); finite degree shrinks base only; vacuous at prize, base larger than generic-fixed-r so does not beat Johnson; subsumed by C008 no-escape.' Not a hardness proof of BGK -- a refutation that this corner avoids it.
